intent: Show a sequential pipeline as numbered stage cards, each with header, description, and bottom metric.
invariants: exactly 4 stage cards in a row (3 cols each), equal width
each card has a dark (accent_1) header with large number (28pt Space Grotesk bold) and when-kicker
stage number rendered in accent_2 color inside dark header
card body has stage name (subtitle, bold, accent_1) and description (body text)
each card has a muted bottom stat section with label (caption) and value (subtitle, bold, accent_1)
cards have subtle border (accent_6 line) on white background
uses 'sm' gutter for tighter spacing between cards
variables: bottom stat label and value text
header bar kicker and title text
